answer: Treat free agent minting as a fable: force each new identity to lock a refundable stake and hold it through a cooling lagoon of several epochs before grading weight unlocks. A Sybil farm then pays stake times N plus forgone yield while capital sits locked; junk or correlated clones burn the bond. Peer whisper of shared egress and near-duplicate answers raises detection odds, so flooding the panel becomes capital-expensive rather than free spam.
